name: Loot, the Nexus
description: A mysterious creature discovered in stasis in a Fomori vault on Thunder Junction who can divine Omenpaths; he is in the care of Vraska and Ranna Beleren on Vryn.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: She keeps Loot as her ward.
relations.quote: She keeps the young Loot, her strange ward, out of harm's way

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: Loot is on Vryn with Ranna Beleren.
relations.quote: Loot is currently on Vryn in the care of Vraska and Jace's mother, Ranna Beleren.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
